scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: supervised latent factorization of the 13 service ratings. Learn low-dimensional passenger embeddings that predict satisfaction, using the ratings as input features.

H52_FACTORIZATION_SIGNAL.question: Does a supervised low-rank factorization of the 13 service ratings (rating matrix factorization with satisfaction as supervision) produce features that improve fold-0 OOF AUC?
H52_FACTORIZATION_SIGNAL.method: Cross-fit low-rank matrix factorization of the 13 ratings: learn passenger embeddings (rank R=8) and rating embeddings, with satisfaction as the supervised target (binary logistic). Use a PyTorch model (like FactLog but on ratings only) trained on folds 1-4, predict fold-0 passenger embeddings (R dims). Add to rich view, LGBM fold-0.
H52_FACTORIZATION_SIGNAL.leakage: Factorization trained on FIT only (folds 1-4), predicting fold-0 passenger embeddings. Satisfaction label only used in FIT. Fold-safe.
H52_FACTORIZATION_SIGNAL.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
